en.question: How much does Cloud Pro cost?
en.answer:
We expect Cloud Pro to cost between $2.50 and $3.50 USD per month, or a one-time lifetime unlock between $50 and $90 USD.

We're publishing these figures for transparency — the final numbers will be finalized and published here soon. Your device and Cloud Basic service are never affected by this.

es.question: ¿Cuánto cuesta Cloud Pro?
es.answer:

Publicamos estas cifras por transparencia — los números finales se definirán y publicarán aquí muy pronto. Tu dispositivo y el servicio Cloud Basic nunca se ven afectados por esto.
